packageDocs.summary: Media library: upload/list/delete UI backed by /api/media-library/media* route handlers (server-side, require x-gateway-sub header injected by the gateway middleware). Uploads go to Supabase Storage; changes stream over Realtime.
requiresEnv: NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL (optional — when media routes are served via the API gateway)
requiresProviders: AuthProvider (required — components read the session token via loadTokens())

MediaLibraryModal.description: Modal that lists, searches, uploads, and soft-deletes the signed-in user's media. Requires a valid access token (loadTokens()) and mounts Realtime for live updates.
notes: apiBasePath resolves via mediaApiBase() — gateway URL or same-origin /api/media-library.

MediaPage.description: Standalone page that opens the MediaLibraryModal.

Providers.description: Media library app provider: wraps children in @machi-asia/auth AuthGate. Optional authApiUrl prop.
